title: Existence of pure capillary solitary waves in constant vorticity flows
summary: We prove that the finite-depth pure-capillary rigidity mechanism in the irrotational water-wave problem is destroyed by a suitable constant-vorticity critical shear. More precisely, we construct small-amplitude finite-depth pure capillary solitary waves for the two-dimensional free-boundary Euler equations with nonzero constant vorticity and zero gravity. The waves bifurcate from a critical shear flow whose relative horizontal velocity vanishes at the bed, so that the standard Dubreil--Jacotin no-stagnation formulation is singular at the asymptotic state.
